licence.quote_locus: web.dev/articles/inp footer (verbatim, same sentence reproduced on the Site Policies page)
licence.second_quote_le_15_words: Google's trademarks and other brand features are not included in this license
licence.third_quote_le_15_words: images, audio or video material, or a link to content on a different webpage
licence.third_quote_locus: Site Policies, 'What is not licensed?' — such content 'is not covered by the license, unless specifically noted'
licence.grants_our_words: Copy, modify, translate and reuse the page text, with attribution to Google in the prescribed form and a link back to the source page; code samples under Apache 2.0.
licence.forbids_our_words: Using Google brand features; treating images, video or linked content as licensed; omitting the attribution paragraph.
licence.attribution_form_required_our_words: For exact reproduction, a paragraph stating that portions are reproduced from work created and shared by Google under CC BY 4.0, plus a link to the source page; a parallel paragraph for modified versions.
licence.ai_clause: none in the notice or the policies

permits_us: reproduce — text verbatim with the prescribed attribution paragraph and a link back; paraphrase — permitted, with the 'modifications based on' form of the paragraph; NOT the diagrams/SVGs (images excluded)
why_our_words: R1 guessed CC BY 'by convention' and was right, but a guess is not a receipt; this lane has the sentence from the page and the exclusions from the policy. The thing to remember is the images: the INP threshold diagram is an image and is outside the licence even though the numbers in the text are inside it.
unproven: Whether every web.dev page carries the same footer — only /articles/inp was fetched in this lane; R1 also cites /articles/vitals (fetched at #236, licence not captured then). 'Except as otherwise noted' means a per-page check on import. Price: one fetch per page imported.

pitfalls.what: The threshold figures live in text (licensed) AND in an SVG (not licensed). A node that embeds the diagram breaches; a node that states the numbers does not.
pitfalls.owner: P2 membership rule author; generator's asset-import path

pitfalls.what: The attribution is a specific paragraph plus a link, not a bare 'Source: Google'. A generator that emits CWV text into a client deliverable owes that paragraph on the deliverable.
'Last updated 2025-09-02' — thresholds and definitions can move (the page keeps a changelog). A node without a fetch date will drift.
